corresponds to the letter yud of the Name Havayah,
which is Chochmah, the Supernal Kodesh,
for then is the time of Matan Torah
from the side of the Tree of Life
corresponds to the letter vav of the Name Havayah;
that is, it alludes to the time after the downfall:
there was need for the Torah she'b'al peh,
so that there no longer be
a mixture of good and evil,
and the words of Torah will be
only from the side of the Tree of Life,
to which the letter vav alludes:
to Yom Tov Sheni shel Galuyos,
for this is needed in exile,
when the "abundance of wisdom" is needed,
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
to repair it so that there no longer be
anything from the Tree of Good and Evil,
but only from the Tree of Life.
